preconditions.description: The number of points is between 1 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
The coordinates of each point are positive rational numbers represented by two integers each.

postconditions.description: The number of moves performed is equal to the number of moves described in the output.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in moves)
postconditions.description: Each move involves two distinct points.

postconditions.expression: all(x_a + 1 == x_new_a or y_a + 1 == y_new_a for a, b in moves for x_a, y_a, x_new_a, y_new_a in points if a == i)
postconditions.description: Each point a in a move is moved to a new coordinate such that the line through the new coordinates of a, the new coordinates of b, and (0, 0) exists.

postconditions.expression: all(x_b + 1 == x_new_b or y_b + 1 == y_new_b for a, b in moves for x_b, y_b, x_new_b, y_new_b in points if b == i)
postconditions.description: Each point b in a move is moved to a new coordinate such that the line through the new coordinates of a, the new coordinates of b, and (0, 0) exists.

postconditions.expression: all(not any((a, b) in moves_set or (b, a) in moves_set for a, b in combinations(range(1, n + 1), 2)) for moves_set in (set(moves),))
postconditions.description: No point is involved in more than one move.
